# ScienceDirect
> ScienceDirect is Elsevier’s platform for accessing peer-reviewed journals, books, and article metadata across scientific, technical, and medical disciplines.

It provides discovery, browsing, and access to scholarly literature, including journal issues, books, articles, abstracts, author information, and topic collections spanning the physical sciences, life sciences, health sciences, and social sciences.

## Core Platform
- [ScienceDirect Home](https://www.sciencedirect.com/): Main entry point for searching and browsing journals, books, and articles.
- [Search](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search): Search interface for articles, book chapters, and publication content.
- [Advanced Search](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search/advanced): Advanced search with fielded queries and filtering options.
- [Browse Publications](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books): Directory for browsing all journals and books on the platform.
- [Topics](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics): Curated topic pages connecting concepts, definitions, and related literature.
- [About ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/about): Overview of the platform, content, and access model.

## Journals and Books
- [Journals A–Z](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?contentType=JL): Browse all journals available on ScienceDirect.
- [Books A–Z](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?contentType=BK): Browse all books and reference works available on ScienceDirect.
- [Open Access Journals](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?accessType=openAccess&contentType=JL): Browse journals with open access availability.
- [Open Access Books](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?accessType=openAccess&contentType=BK): Browse books with open access availability.
- [Latest Publications](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books): Browse recently indexed and available publication titles.

## Articles and Content Types
- [Articles](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search?articleTypes=FLA): Search full-length research articles across the platform.
- [Review Articles](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search?articleTypes=REV): Search review articles and synthesis papers.
- [Book Chapters](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search?contentType=BK): Search chapters and book-based scholarly content.
- [Open Access Content](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search?accessType=openAccess): Search openly accessible articles and chapters.
- [Recent Articles](https://www.sciencedirect.com/search?date=2020-2029): Search recent publication output using date filters.

## Subject Areas
- [Physical Sciences and Engineering](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?subject=physical-sciences-and-engineering): Browse publications in physical sciences and engineering.
- [Life Sciences](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?subject=life-sciences): Browse journals and books in life sciences.
- [Health Sciences](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?subject=health-sciences): Browse health and medical science publications.
- [Social Sciences and Humanities](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?subject=social-sciences-and-humanities): Browse social sciences and humanities content.
- [Mathematics](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?subject=mathematics): Browse mathematics journals and books.
- [Computer Science](https://www.sciencedirect.com/browse/journals-and-books?subject=computer-science): Browse computer science publications.

## Author and Publication Information
- [Authors](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/authors): Information and tools relevant to article authors on ScienceDirect.
- [Editors](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/editors): Information for editors involved with journals and editorial workflows.
- [Author Affiliations](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167739X19320964): Example article page showing author, affiliation, and metadata structure.
- [Journal Information Pages](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/artificial-intelligence): Example journal homepage with aims, scope, and issue navigation.
- [Book Information Pages](https://www.sciencedirect.com/book/9780128154809/deep-learning): Example book page with chapters and publication metadata.

## Access and User Support
- [Help Center](https://service.elsevier.com/app/home/supporthub/sciencedirect/): Official support hub for ScienceDirect users.
- [Remote Access](https://service.elsevier.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/25944/supporthub/sciencedirect/): Guidance for accessing ScienceDirect remotely through institutions.
- [Access Troubleshooting](https://service.elsevier.com/app/answers/list/supporthub/sciencedirect/): Support articles for common access and account issues.
- [Contact Support](https://service.elsevier.com/app/home/supporthub/sciencedirect/): Entry point for contacting Elsevier support about ScienceDirect.
- [Librarian Support](https://www.elsevier.com/librarians): Elsevier resources and services for librarians managing access.

## APIs and Developer Resources
- [Elsevier Developer Portal](https://dev.elsevier.com/): Central portal for Elsevier APIs, keys, and developer documentation.
- [Scopus APIs](https://dev.elsevier.com/sc_apis.html): API documentation for Scopus content and metadata services.
- [ScienceDirect APIs Overview](https://dev.elsevier.com/api_docs.html): Overview of available Elsevier APIs relevant to content retrieval and metadata.
- [Article Retrieval API](https://dev.elsevier.com/documentation/ArticleRetrievalAPI.wadl): API for retrieving article metadata and content representations.
- [Search API](https://dev.elsevier.com/documentation/SCIDIRSearchAPI.wadl): API for searching ScienceDirect and related Elsevier content.
- [API Authentication](https://dev.elsevier.com/tecdoc_api_authentication.html): Authentication methods and API key usage for Elsevier services.

## Open Access and Research Discovery
- [Open Access Hub](https://www.sciencedirect.com/open-access): Overview of open access content and availability on ScienceDirect.
- [Open Archive](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal-profiles/open-access): Journal open access information and publication models.
- [Topic Pages](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics): Topic overviews linking concepts to books and articles.
- [Recommended Articles](https://www.sciencedirect.com/): Platform entry point featuring discovery and recommendation features.
